project: pimp-my-site: self-hosted loop where a cookieless tracker measures visitors, an AI agent proposes variant JSON changes, and a weekly rule on "stayed 30s" picks winners a human approves (Node 22+ TypeScript npm workspace + static site)

help.studyKinds: What this project expects to compare: code, library, engine, cli, service, agent, other.
help.existingTools: Benchmark or measuring tools already in use (hyperfine, vitest bench, ffmpeg/vmaf, docker...). Studies call them; the kit does not replace them.
help.services: Base URLs for the http adapter, by name: { "staging": "http://127.0.0.1:8080" }.
help.prices: Only needed to ESTIMATE agent cost. Never guessed. Shape: { "provider/model": { "inputPerMTok": 0, "outputPerMTok": 0, "cacheReadPerMTok": 0, "cacheWritePerMTok": 0, "source": "pricing page URL", "asOf": "YYYY-MM-DD" } }, USD per million tokens.
